title: Elie Mystal on Elon Musk’s vision of neo-apartheid. “First and most important,...
content: Elie Mystal on Elon Musk’s vision of neo-apartheid. “First and most important, apartheid is a business plan. It’s a system designed to exploit cheap Black labor, without ever letting Black people reap the financial and social gains of hard work.”
author: Jason Kottke
